Trade direction (bought vs sold) not determinable from volume alone.
skew_note: Upside skew. 2026-08-21 expiry: $39 call IV ~289% vs $24 put IV ~253%. 2026-08-28: 161% vs 151%. Computed by the analyst from chain marks.
